Persistent Identifier Services & Developer Tools
The Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) offers persistent identifier services and developer tools to ensure that DOE researchers have efficient access to the research and development (R&D) information they need to speed the pace of discovery.  Through the tools below, we aim to provide comprehensive data support for records available on OSTI.GOV and other search tools.
